_about: What the Stripe source does not offer (REQ-1957, REQ-1923): Stripe's deprecated legacy payment integration -- the Charges and Customers APIs given a card/bank token or inline card data, the Tokens API and the Sources API. Stripe restricts these for new integrations and flags an account that sends them. Payments are taken through Payment Intents, Payment Methods and Setup Intents, which the specification offers. Reading and deleting payment sources an account already has stays on offer, as do Connect external accounts, Issuing cards and the Payment Methods API's own `card`. `default_source` names a source that already exists and is not excluded. Applied when the shipped specification is loaded; an entry the specification no longer has fails the load until it is removed.
